note: USACE campground on a narrow wooded peninsula in Lake Cumberland, its 10 back-in sites strung along the spine with water on both sides, 10-20 m above summer pool. Boat ramp, playground and a picnic shelter. Sites 05 and 06 take rigs only to about 25 ft. --Claude
summary: Kept, lakeview unchanged (rec.gov's 'all waterfront' is loose: pads 10-20 m above summer pool). Fees $26, 50A + water, 10 back-in sites to 61 ft, flush toilets/showers/water/dump, season 2027 05-13..09-19 (was approx. mid-May..mid-Oct), rec.gov with 14-night limit, military discount. Note rewritten.

The closest, site 06 (36.922121,-84.846698), is 229.3 m with summer pool at ~11 m: ~9 m above over a steep bank. Site 01 reaches pool at ~24 m, 12.7 m above.
